description: Flat metadata schema for individual records describing synthetic herbicide compounds, their analytical characterization, and in vitro bioactivity/toxicity testing across plant enzymes, pathways, and species.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for this metadata record or assay result row.

compound_id.descr: Unique compound identifier assigned by the laboratory or database.

compound_name.descr: Common name, code name, or internal project name of the herbicide compound.

compound_inchi.descr: Standard InChI string for the compound, if available.

compound_inchikey.descr: Standard InChIKey for the compound, if available.

compound_smiles.descr: Canonical SMILES representation of the molecular structure.

chemical_formula.descr: Molecular formula of the compound, for example C12H15ClN2O3.

molecular_weight_da.descr: Molecular weight of the compound in daltons (Da).

compound_class.descr: Chemical class or scaffold, for example sulfonylurea, triazine, pyridine, or novel analog.

synthesis_route_summary.descr: Brief description of the synthetic route or preparation method used to produce the compound.

synthesis_batch_id.descr: Identifier for the synthesis batch or lot.

synthesis_date.descr: Date the compound batch was synthesized.

purity_percent.descr: Estimated or measured compound purity in percent (%) based on analytical characterization.

storage_conditions.descr: Storage conditions for the compound, for example -20 C, dry, protected from light.

nmr_method.descr: NMR method used for characterization, for example 1H NMR, 13C NMR, 2D COSY, HSQC.

nmr_solvent.descr: Solvent used for the NMR experiment, for example CDCl3 or DMSO-d6.

nmr_field_strength_mhz.descr: NMR spectrometer field strength in MHz.

nmr_peak_count.descr: Number of resolved NMR peaks reported for the compound.

nmr_identity_confirmed.descr: Whether NMR data were consistent with the proposed molecular structure.

ms_method.descr: Mass spectrometry method used, for example ESI-MS, MALDI-TOF, HRMS.

ms_ion_mode.descr: Mass spectrometry ionization or acquisition mode, for example positive or negative.

ms_observed_mz.descr: Observed mass-to-charge ratio (m/z) for the major molecular ion or adduct.

ms_theoretical_mz.descr: Theoretical mass-to-charge ratio (m/z) expected for the proposed ion/adduct.

ms_mass_error_ppm.descr: Mass error in parts per million (ppm) between observed and theoretical m/z.

ms_identity_confirmed.descr: Whether mass spectrometry data supported the proposed molecular identity.

logp.descr: Calculated or measured octanol-water partition coefficient as logP.

pka.descr: Acid dissociation constant pKa, if measured or estimated.

solubility_mg_per_ml.descr: Aqueous or assay-relevant solubility in mg/mL, if measured.

stability_hours.descr: Chemical or assay stability duration in hours under specified conditions.

test_species.descr: Plant species used in the assay, for example Arabidopsis thaliana, Zea mays, or Oryza sativa.

species_taxon_id.descr: Taxonomic identifier for the plant species, if available.

sample_type.descr: Biological material used in the assay, for example whole plant, leaf tissue, callus, cell suspension, or enzyme extract.

target_name.descr: Plant enzyme, protein, pathway, or cellular process assessed in the assay.

target_family.descr: Higher-level biological family or pathway class of the target, for example amino acid biosynthesis, photosynthesis, or cell division.

assay_name.descr: Name of the bioactivity or toxicity assay performed.

assay_type.descr: Assay category, for example enzyme inhibition, cell viability, germination inhibition, or pathway reporter assay.

assay_format.descr: Experimental format, for example in vitro, ex vivo, or cell-based.

assay_protocol_reference.descr: Protocol identifier, publication reference, or internal SOP used for the assay.

incubation_time_hours.descr: Incubation time between compound exposure and endpoint measurement in hours.

vehicle_control.descr: Vehicle used to dissolve or deliver the compound, for example DMSO or ethanol.

vehicle_percent_vv.descr: Final vehicle concentration in percent volume/volume (% v/v), if applicable.

replicate_count.descr: Number of technical or biological replicates included for this measurement.

assay_readout_name.descr: Primary readout measured, for example fluorescence, absorbance, enzyme activity, or luminescence.

assay_readout_value.descr: Observed raw or processed assay readout value.

assay_readout_unit.descr: Unit for the assay readout value, for example RFU, OD450, percent inhibition, or relative activity.

percent_inhibition.descr: Percent inhibition of target activity relative to control, if applicable.

percent_activation.descr: Percent activation relative to control, if applicable.

ic50_um.descr: Half-maximal inhibitory concentration in micromolar (uM), if determined.

ec50_um.descr: Half-maximal effective concentration in micromolar (uM), if determined.

ki_um.descr: Inhibition constant Ki in micromolar (uM), if determined.

hill_slope.descr: Hill slope from dose-response fitting, if available.

top_response_percent.descr: Maximum response or efficacy at high concentration, expressed as percent.

selectivity_index.descr: Ratio or index describing selectivity between intended target and off-target or toxicity endpoint.

toxicity_observed.descr: Whether toxicity or adverse effect was observed in the assay system.

toxicity_endpoint.descr: Specific toxicity endpoint measured, for example chlorosis, necrosis, reduced growth, or cell death.

cytotoxicity_ic50_um.descr: Concentration causing 50 percent cytotoxicity or growth inhibition in micromolar (uM), if applicable.

hit_call.descr: Binary or categorical hit designation encoded as a descriptive label, for example active, inactive, weak_hit, toxic_hit.

result_interpretation.descr: Brief interpretive summary of the compound's potency, selectivity, and toxicity in the tested context.

reference_standard_id.descr: Identifier of a comparator herbicide or assay standard used for benchmarking, if any.

reference_standard_name.descr: Name of the comparator herbicide or assay standard, if any.

normalized_activity_percent.descr: Activity normalized to a reference control, expressed as percent.

data_quality_flag.descr: Quality flag indicating record reliability, for example pass, warning, or fail.

notes.descr: Additional free-text notes relevant to the record, including deviations, anomalies, or special conditions.
